reviews.author: kristina barkauskyte
reviews.text: Lovely Food, but Disappointing Customer Service Today, we visited Maki & Ramen with friends. This wasn’t our first visit, and there’s a reason we decided to come back! The food was absolutely lovely, as always, and the atmosphere was really nice too. Unfortunately, our experience took a disappointing turn when it came time to pay. When we approached the till and asked about our bill, the gentleman serving us already seemed visibly unhappy and irritated. However, things got even worse when we politely asked if we could pay separately. His reaction was completely unnecessary. He threw the card machine aside and looked at us as though we had asked for our food for free! We were honestly shocked by his attitude. Asking to split a bill is a perfectly normal request, and no customer should be made to feel uncomfortable or unwelcome for simply asking. Thankfully, another gentleman came over, and he was the complete opposite — very friendly, polite and happy to help us with exactly what we had asked for. We really appreciated his kindness and professionalism. Unfortunately, despite the delicious food and lovely atmosphere, the behaviour of the first staff member left a very unpleasant feeling and spoiled what had otherwise been a great visit. We genuinely enjoy coming to Maki & Ramen, which makes this experience even more disappointing. Good food brings customers in, but good customer service is what makes them want to return. Hopefully, this is something management will take seriously, as no customer deserves to be treated that way.

reviews.author: B H
reviews.text: I would like to give a special mention to Cameron, the manager for his kindness towards us at the restaurant. Staff, food and atmosphere are great but unfortunately, there was an issue with our food. Cameron ensured that the matter was dealt with in a professional manner and our food was replaced quickly to our satisfaction. Cameron handled the situation exceptionally well. He listened to our concerns, showed genuine understanding and treated us with respect and professionalism throughout. He was understanding of the religious significance of the situation and made sure the issue was addressed. Mistakes can happen in any restaurant, but the way a member of management responds makes all the difference. Cameron demonstrated excellent customer service, empathy and professionalism, and we genuinely appreciated how he dealt with everything. Thank you, Cameron, for taking our concerns seriously and making us feel heard. You handled a difficult situation very well, and your approach deserves recognition! Will recommend this place to everyone Thank you

The Vegan Hell Ramen was superb — rich in flavour, delicious, and satisfying, with a perfect blend of spices that made every bite enjoyable. It was definitely a highlight of our meal! The Mount Fuji drink was equally fantastic, refreshing, unique, and a perfect complement to the ramen. Food and service was fine, but the entire atmosphere, from the comically large drum at the entrance, to the loud music, pink lighting and enormous geisha at the back of the restaurant seem curated for a perfectly instagramable experience conveniently distracting from the actual food. There was so much going on the food didn't leave much of an impression.

reviews.text: The food was okay but quite salty and overcooked and undercooked at the same time. There wasn't any black garlic in the black garlic tonkotsu. The gyoza, while tasty, felt like it was cooked from frozen. The way it looks is amazing, but the music was really loud and I couldn't hear my partner.

reviews.author: Lily Abed
reviews.text: Food was bland i had the chicken ramen, however to be fair the tempura starter was really good. service was slow because when I ordered an alcoholic drink that had the bubble sitting on top, it was left sitting on their counter that by the time it came to our table it was just foam so felt dissapointed that i couldn't have the drink the way I saw its picture on the menu. Its not worth the hype, its nice visuals but the food isnt worth it.

reviews.author: Danisan Sivakumar
reviews.text: It was my first visiting in Birmingham so I thought of trying food at your place. Very disappointed and felt like I was ignored and not welcomed. It was really busy so I requested the male manager (British tall man) that any chance I could sit in the corner I didn’t wanna sit in the middle of the crowd. He refused it and said that table is only for three people you can sit and was trying to seat me in the middle of a big group. I then refused and again requested to sit in the corner. Finally he did, no one came to take my order, felt like I was targeted. While I was waiting to be served there were some Japanese couple came and he gave them a big table but it was only two people so I thought he is discriminating me. Finally a server came, she didn’t even ask whether I have any allergies, she took my order. I called the female manager and said that I have gluten intolerance so could you please guide me or explain the option but she didn’t. I ordered a stater, a main, a drink and a glass of water. Main came first no drinks at all, starter came later still no water or drink at all. By the time I started eating I asked more than 3 times that whether I could have my drinks at least. Since I got allergy, after having the food, I was waiting to catch my train to come back home. I had server vomiting and diarrhoea in the train. It was because of their ignorance and careless behaviour. I said to that Chinese lady manager that I have allergy she didn’t even care about me. I’m gonna severely take action against their behaviour which is not suitable for the hospitality and I’m looking forward to the head office to contact me to discuss about my health issue. There was another man who was trying to get the payment, he was like forcing me to pay the 10% service charge as if they gave the best guest experience. I would like to claim my full refund that I paid for the meal and I need a proper explanation form the management.

reviews.author: Sophia Khan
reviews.text: Unfortunately, this was a really disappointing experience. The sushi itself was okay, but nothing particularly memorable, and the overall standard of service and cleanliness let the evening down significantly. We waited around 30 minutes just to receive the bill, despite the restaurant not feeling especially busy. The service also felt quite unprofessional at times. We could see staff eating hand rolls during service, and the general presentation of the restaurant did not feel particularly polished. More importantly, our glasses were visibly smudged and some of the plates did not appear properly clean, which was quite off-putting in a sushi restaurant. The staff were friendly, which I do want to acknowledge, but unfortunately the service was very disorganised and the overall experience did not feel up to the standard I would expect for the price. I hope these are issues the restaurant can address, as there is definitely room for improvement.

reviews.author: Charli Maggs
reviews.text: Service was horrendous…. Atmosphere was too bright. Walked in, to a sight full of dirty glassware, yet place was empty. Took ages to get attention for anything and be served any drinks. Even getting the bill took time. Emailed to give feedback after, still no response. Will not be recommending.
